material_findings: audit_corpus and parse_window verify the selected document identities and retained window hashes but never verify that each window's token IDs equal the first 1024 token IDs of its claimed source row; they also do not require a unique path under the declared split. Arbitrary, reused, cross-split, or prior-pilot window bytes can therefore be accepted while carrying valid claimed source hashes, so exact data identity and evaluated-content disjointness are not established.

validate_result accepts assessment_per_document rows in any permutation and feeds that supplied order directly into the SHA-256-counter bootstrap. Because the finite deterministic resample weights are index-dependent, reordering the same document deltas can change the confidence limits while still validating; the canonical runner order is not independently enforced or reconstructed.
